text:
ria: quick preflight — tiny async standup for next-week launch. TL;DR: spec PR up, need TTL decision and canary plan. PR: #456. blocking on final spec comments + routing TTL. cc @sam @jordan

sam: saw the PR, I'll do a review today OOO in afternoon but can push feedback by 3pm PT. for TTL i'd lean 1h default then tune.

jordan: 1h seems fine for steady traffic but for cold-start-sensitive flows i prefer 30m. added a short note in the spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/spreadsheet-launch (row: routing-ttl).

maria: QA — we can run smoke + regression Wed morning. can we freeze schema and model pin by EOD tomorrow? otherwise tests will drift.

ria: aim is EOD tomorrow for freeze. if we can't lock TTL by then, we can default to 1h and follow up with patch. maria — thanks, that schedule works.

lee: i can wire a simple canary route today — proposing 10% traffic to v2-quant. will open infra ticket INF-789 and add autoscale guardrails.

ria: perfect, @lee please include rollback policy (instant fallback to v1) and health checks. also need a short runbook blurb for on-call.

lee: adding now. snippet for canary config i'm planning to push:```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  model_variant: v2-quant
  health_check: /healthz
  rollback_on_errors: true
```

sam: small note on model_variant name — in serving catalog it's `v2-quantized` (two words). i'll update PR to match.

jordan: also flagging perf bench — we saw 8% higher p99 with v2-quantized on long sequences. file: s3://benchmarks/2026-03-v2-quantized.json. worth rolling perf tests into the canary.

maria: QA will include perf smoke (90th token latency) in the suite. if p99 regresses >10% we'll hold the rollout.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] 2310001250 — canary cluster created (cluster-canary-42). logs streaming: https://logs.redwood/canary-42

ria: next actions: sam to PR review by 3pm, lee opens INF-789 and creates canary route, jordan to attach perf baseline, maria to run Wed smoke, ria to finalize spec TTL (defaults to 1h if unresolved). i'll post a quick checklist once INF-789 is up. :rocket: 

sam: ack — will update PR and ping when done.

jordan: i'll attach perf + short checklist.

maria: noted, will prep test entry points.

ria: thanks team — ping here if anything blocks.
